title: Concept: Free-text transaction narration exposed in a response
description: A transaction object that carries a free-text narration next to its amount in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Narrations are typed by operators and often name the payer, the purpose or a reference that ties the account to a person, so echoing them widens who can read the payment history.
applicability: Deployments that render a transaction object that carries a free-text narration next to its amount into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Narrations are typed by operators and often name the payer, the purpose or a reference that ties the account to a person, so echoing them widens who can read the payment history.
